svg.title: Build 002: Multi-Audience Meaning Architecture — official-source context cover
svg.desc: Official GOV.UK user-research guidance stating that teams must understand all kinds of users and write needs using words users recognise, shown as source context for Build 002. Bounded official-source excerpt; not evidence of prototype performance or institutional endorsement.
svg.text: You must understand the needs of all kinds of users,
Write user needs from a personal perspective using
words that users would recognise and use themselves.
GOV.UK guidance: include all kinds of users and preserve words users recognise.
Supports the need to represent multiple audiences and preserve user-recognisable language; it
does not validate RN’s architecture, prove outcomes or imply endorsement.
GOV.UK SERVICE MANUAL · FAITHFUL TEXT COMPOSITE
